title: Kicked Up Canadian Salmon Skewers
description: A herbal and energizing Canadian dish featuring tamarind pulp and miso-marinate, this recipe is perfect for a dinner meal. The ayurvedic-rajasic friendly ingredients will leave you feeling refreshed and revitalized.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, tamarind pulp mixture, maple syrup, and lemon juice.
Add the garlic and ginger to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the salmon pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the salmon pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the salmon is cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
